reason: An entity with the default-namespace attributes mine and type serialises to PROV-JSONLD that validates against the vendored submission schema. The vendored schema's patternProperties require each key to have the shape prefix:local, and a bare key for a default-namespace attribute does not match, so the output must key it by an absolute IRI.

Each canonical example document serialises to PROV-JSONLD, in url and embed context mode, that validates against the vendored submission schema, and the example that holds a mentionOf statement raises ProvJSONLDException instead. The PROV-JSONLD submission schema vendored under src/prov/tests/schemas defines the valid output, and conformance caveat C2 in docs/reference/conformance.md says the format has no Mention term and the writer raises.

Each of four vendored PROV-JSONLD fixture files, in the submission's dialect, validates against the vendored schema. The fixtures are compatibility fixtures in the submission's dialect (src/prov/tests/jsonld), and the vendored schema defines the valid shape.

An entity with a qualified-name value under ex:ref and prov:value serialises to PROV-JSONLD in which ex:ref is the node reference with the key @id, and the container validates against the vendored submission schema. A qualified-name value is written as a node reference (#564), and the vendored schema defines the valid shape of the container.
